Package com.example.eventlottery.controller

Class ProfileController

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlottery.controller.ProfileController
public class ProfileController extends Object
Controller for managing user profile operations. Acts as an intermediary between the UI and repositories. Supports: - profile retrieval and updates - profile deletion - notification preference toggling - deletion of organizer-owned events during account deletion User stories supported: - US 01.02.01 / US 01.02.02: Provide/update personal info - US 01.02.04: Delete profile - US 01.04.03: Opt out of receiving notifications
Version:
1.3
Author:
Dmitriy Limanets, Fawaz Mansoor, Kenneth Joseph
